mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a risk premium adjustment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) after inflation crosses the threshold, or the S&P 500 shows no mean reversion to the pre-inflation level in the following 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in PAYEMS labor claims exceeding the prior month's by more than 10,000 signals labor market stress, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day ahead returns remain positive despite the trigger, or the effect dissipates within 5 days and is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% suggests strengthening demand, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the trend reverses within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 50 (annualized) indicates supply-side weakness, which is expected to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 5% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to turn negative due to tightened financing conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or the effect is not robust across multiple such episodes (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE unemployment below 4% in a month is accompanied by a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as labor market tightness supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the effect vanishes within 1 quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in HOUST housing starts and RSAFS retail sales above their prior month's levels jointly predict a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return, reflecting coordinated demand across sectors.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or 20-day returns are not positive in at least 70% of such triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS retail sales fall by more than 5% from the prior month during a recession regime (as defined by UNRATE > 6%), the S&P 500 5-day forward return is expected to be negative due to weak demand absorption.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive or the regime condition is not met at the time of the signal.
